courseDescription: Become proficient in front-end web development. Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and popular frameworks like Bootstrap and React. Build interactive and responsive websites.
Master the principles of user interface and user experience design. Learn to create wireframes, prototypes, and user flows using modern design tools to craft intuitive digital experiences.
Dive into the world of mobile application development. Learn how to build, test, and deploy functional, cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android devices.
Unlock your creativity with graphic design essentials. Understand layout theory, typography, color matching, and digital illustration to create stunning visual content.
